home.bannerBody: New NWU papers land in the library regularly — search by subject, module, and grade.
home.liveAnchorUnavailable: The library is being refreshed — papers are added regularly. Check back soon.
home.heroTitle: Grade 10–12 past papers, and a tutor that still answers on a weak signal.
home.heroSubtitle: CAPS papers open without an account. Hints stay on your phone when they can, so a small data bundle still gets you through the question.
home.proofDetail0: CAPS-aligned school content and full NWU module support in one place.
home.proofDetail1: Built with the rigour of enterprise-grade infrastructure and offered openly — because access to quality education should not depend on the size of your wallet.
home.proofDetail2: Works on limited data. No heavy video, no forced downloads.
home.howItWorksHeading: Better than a WhatsApp group for studying.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Module rooms keep questions scoped to your subject. Accepted answers earn Scholar Credits. Anonymous posting means no one is afraid to ask.
home.step01Body: Ask in your module room. Be specific or vague — someone in your campus has the same question.
home.step02Body: Students who already figured it out reply. React with 'same question' to get notified when it's answered.
home.step03Body: Mark the most helpful reply as accepted. The answerer earns 20 Scholar Credits. Everyone benefits.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Post a question in your module room and get answers from classmates who've already figured it out. Mark an answer as accepted and earn Scholar Credits.
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Hints prefer the model on your phone. Longer marking falls back to the cloud. Built for a small data bundle.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: Official past papers by province, grade, and subject. No account needed to browse. The most complete SA past paper library available online.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: One targeted quiz a day. Identifies your weak areas and sends you questions that fix them. Keep your streak alive and climb the leaderboard.
home.featurePlannerDesc: CAPS-aligned for school learners. Upload-based for university students. Your timetable, structured around what actually needs to get done.
home.featureGamesDesc: BRAZIL, a student survival text adventure, is live now. Exam Dash — timed MCQ with Scholar Credits — just launched. More games coming.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: Built for the South African student — not a generic global platform bolted onto local content.
home.trustCopy0: Grade R through postgrad. CAPS-aligned school content and full NWU module support in one login.
home.trustCopy1: Open access by design. Data-light for South African connections. No credit card, no heavy video, no forced downloads — the cost of what sits behind this platform is ours to carry.
home.trustCopy2: Community, AI tutor, past papers, daily quiz, study planner, and games — all under one roof.
home.trustCopy3: Direct and warm. No corporate speak, no fake urgency. SCHOOL says what it means.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Last paper added {relativeDate}. The library keeps growing.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Curious what else is on the platform? See everything that's live — and what's coming next.
home.missionHeading: Built for every South African. Designed to leave no one behind.
home.missionPara1: SCHOOL was founded by Moloti Ditshego not as an online school, but as a living blend of arts, sciences, philosophies, and teachings drawn from many — assembled to enable a better future for all South Africans, without racial or cultural exclusion.
home.missionPara2: The engineering and architecture behind this platform is precise and not cheap. It was conceived through lived experience and executed through rigorous work. What you encounter here was built with the kind of conviction that comes from believing you have everything you need to pull it off — and then proving it.
home.missionPara3Pre: Moloti draws on what he calls the
home.missionPara3Post: — an observation made at a board game: the best way to win is to lead all your pieces together, always waiting for the ones behind, because you will need them later. The mission completes only when all pieces make it home. At SCHOOL, we have accepted that this mission will never fully complete — because the opportunities to extend it are endless.
home.missionPara4: Ditshego Ventures is grateful to everyone who made this possible. Acknowledgements will be given properly — at a formal event, in the way that the work deserves.
home.socialSubtitle: Get study tips, campus news, and community highlights on our official page.
